[LSIG.2.4.1] `onset_rate` reuses the existing `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` ring of rising-edge
timestamps; no new atom is required. On a rising edge the runtime pushes the
timestamp and evicts those older than `current_time − W`. At query time the
count is read-only: the runtime walks the leading entries that have crossed
`t − W` since the last assertion, excludes them, and divides the in-window
count by `min(W, elapsed)` (§[LSIG.1.4]).
